name: The Rainbow Road
description: Catch falling stars to fill a meter. Form a poem on stone slabs. Light 3 torches. Summon the Fire Genie. Answer its question.

stages.name: star-catching
stages.description: Catch falling good stars to fill the meter. Avoid dying stars (lose meter + 1 life).

stages.name: poem-formation
stages.description: Full meter fuses stars into a poem fragment carved on a stone slab.

stages.name: torch-lighting
stages.description: Place 3 stone slabs on podiums to light 3 torches.

stages.name: genie-question
stages.description: Magic Fire Genie appears and asks the meaning of the whole poem.

poems.title: The Unforgotten Flame
poems.meaning: Impact outlasts presence. Even after they are gone, people shape us.
options: Impact outlasts presence. Even after people are gone, they shape us.
The brightest stars live the shortest lives and are soon forgotten.
Stars are only beautiful when they burn forever.
The dawn always ends the night, no matter what.

poems.title: The Road of Steps
fragments: The road is not of stone
But of the steps you take alone
poems.meaning: The journey itself teaches you. Growth comes from walking the road, not from the destination.
options: The journey itself teaches you. Growth comes from walking the road.
A road built of stone is stronger than any path of memories.
Traveling alone means no one can ever help you.
Miles are only worth counting when you arrive early.

poems.title: The Light You Carry
fragments: When the last light dims to gray
Remember how you found the way
Hope is what you carry home
poems.meaning: Hope persists through darkness. What you have learned lights your way home.
options: Hope persists through darkness. What you have learned lights your way home.
When the light fades, it never returns, so be afraid.
Only gray days are worth remembering.
Home is the place where all hope must be left behind.

note: A random poem is chosen on each attempt, so retries give a different poem.
